integrity: The proof supplies the Yule branching identity, a first-order inverse-integral equation, and two-dominant-singularity coefficient transfer. The bundled finite checker gave 683 exact assertions; finite checks are not proofs of infinite asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: The sharp asymptotic is pointwise for fixed \(0<\alpha<1\) on Z/2Z; no uniform endpoint rate, full-history conditional mixing, or other-group extension is claimed. An unindexed general singularity result may supersede the historical novelty claim.
title: Sharp binary step-reinforcement mixing via an inverse beta integral
